title: Token Counter: Please re-add the token counter
body: Please re-add the token counter that would count the tokens sending and receiving. Not sure why it was removed as it shows transparency if Claude is actually working (api) or not.
author: JJsilvera1

top_comments.author: nktl
top_comments.body: Very much needed - PLEASE allow us to have this back, in non-verbose mode (this mode is not useful for regular work)

top_comments.author: bl-ue
top_comments.body: Hi everyone!  We just added a feature to [tweakcc](https://github.com/Piebald-AI/tweakcc) to re-enable the token counter and the elapsed time automatically without having to run Claude Code with `--verbose` option.  To try it out, just run `npx tweakcc` and select the top option, `*Apply customizations to cli.js` and then run `claude`.  Enjoy!

top_comments.author: coygeek
top_comments.body: I'm on v1.0.111 and I can see the token count and timer is back!
